title: The Archive Stirs
description: The Archive woke the moment you arrived. The Triumvirate is waiting in Layer 1. What they want to determine is whether you belong here — or whether you are just passing through.

steps.objective: Enter Layer 1 and witness the Triumvirate manifesting
steps.hint: The gateway shimmers gold. Something massive is waiting behind it.
She won't wait for you to ask politely.
You don't need to win. You need to impress them.

journal_entry: The Triumvirate tested me. I'm still standing, which apparently is the point.
